CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
|-- History boundary and context lifetime
|   |-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService implements CanvasHistoryService
|   |-- private contexts: WeakMap<CanvasEditingContext, CanvasHistory>
|   |   `-- Owns per-handle history; object keys isolate viewers and permit collection.
|   |-- openContext(document, view, record?)
|   |   `-- Creates CanvasHistory and returns a frozen runtime handle.
|   `-- Handles and the service are excluded from saved canvases.
|-- Reads and local history changes
|   |-- state(context): checkpointId, document, view, canUndo, canRedo
|   |   `-- Requires the retained history head and its navigation state.
|   |-- resolve(context, diagramId); document(context)
|   |   `-- Diagram resolution delegates to history.diagrams with contextId.
|   |-- append(context, document, view, correspondence?); reset(context)
|   |   `-- Delegate mutation to the context's CanvasHistory.
|   `-- navigate(context, redo = false)
|       `-- Rejects linked transfers so workspace undo can coordinate participants.
|-- Portable history and transfer interfaces
|   |-- exportContext(context); forkContext(context, view); adopt(context, proposed)
|   |   `-- Callers transport history records without interpreting revision tables.
|   |-- persistenceChanges(context, since?); retireTransactions(context, ids)
|   |-- prepareTransfer(context, input, destination?)
|   |   `-- Requires exported source history and optional destination history.
|   `-- transferBoundary(...); prepareTransferNavigation(source, destination, tx, redo)
|       `-- Boundary checks use the head; navigation requires both exported histories.
|-- Page coordination across canvases
|   |-- transfer(destinationChoice)
|   |   |-- Checks the captured source checkpoint and pauses ordinary persistence.
|   |   `-- Calls runWorkspaceTask({ type: 'transfer', source, destination, input }).
|   |-- undo(id, redo)
|   |   `-- Requires both controllers and orders undo after newer shared transfers.
|   `-- publishTransfer(workspace)
|       |-- Calls storage.save(workspace), then installWorkspace(workspace).
|       `-- Publishes participant histories and the transaction after acknowledgement.
|-- WorkspacePersistence translates live state into records
|   |-- private cursors: WeakMap<CanvasSession, number>; known; subscriptions
|   |   `-- Tracks session deltas and releases subscriptions on disposal.
|   |-- sync(ids); syncView(id); update(activeDocumentId, transfers)
|   |   |-- Require controller history deltas, draft baselines and captured view state.
|   |   `-- historyChanges(id, delta); storage.batch(changes)
|   `-- A replaced history graph deletes obsolete revision and checkpoint records.
|-- RecordStorage manages queued durable writes
|   |-- private cache; pending; flight; running; timer; sequence; persisted; revision
|   |   `-- Batches update the cache and coalesce pending changes by record key.
|   |-- private pump(): Promise<void>
|   |   `-- Sends one flight with requestId and expectedRevision through transport.write.
|   |-- flush(); commit(changes)
|   |   |-- Explicit commits await writes; ambiguous replies retry the same request.
|   |   `-- Definitive rejection restores the prior cache and abandons the flight.
|   `-- dispose()
|       `-- Clears timers and listeners; orderly shutdown requires a prior flush.
`-- WorkspaceStorage manages the worker and record adapter
    |-- private worker; private requests; private ready
    |   `-- Creates a reusable worker and RecordStorage; matches responses to requests.
    |-- load(); project(snapshot); save(snapshot)
    |   `-- Save flushes existing writes, projects records and calls records.commit.
    `-- restore(); flush(); dispose()
        `-- Disposal closes records, terminates the worker and rejects pending requests.
